name: management-pack
title: Group management pack
for_each: select id,code,name from periods order by code

sections.title: Period decision
sections.sql: select code,name,status,reviewed_by,review_note from periods where id=$1
sections.note: Working management report. Not statutory consolidated financial statements. Debit-positive signed balances, group currency NZD.

sections.title: Entity reconciliation
sections.sql: select entity,owner,actual_rows,incomplete_rows,reconciled_by,source_ref from entity_readiness where period_id=$1 order by entity

sections.title: Group results
sections.sql: select scenario,group_code,group_name,kind,base_amount,missing_values from group_results where period_id=$1 order by scenario,group_code

sections.title: Review actions
sections.sql: select code,name,owner,due_on,status,result from actions where period_id=$1 order by due_on

name: elimination-register
title: Elimination working paper
for_each: select id,code,name from journals order by code

sections.title: Journal lines in group currency
sections.sql: select e.code entity,g.code account,g.name,l.amount as base_amount from journal_lines l join entities e on e.id=l.entity_id join group_accounts g on g.id=l.group_id where l.journal_id=$1 order by e.code,g.code
